SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT LEGACY_IV_NO, LEGACY_IV_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM KEP_DA WHERE IF_FLAG = 'E'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KA' AS SITE, 'IV' AS JOB_ID, 'SMT1' AS BUYER, LEGACY_IV_NO AS LEGACY_NO, LEGACY_IV_SEQ AS LEGACY_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO AS REF_NO1, LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS REF_NO2, ERROR_CD AS REF_NO3, BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, ITEM_QTY AS ITEM_QTY FROM KEP_DA WHERE 1 = 1 AND LEGACY_IV_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_IV_NO$' AND LEGACY_IV_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_IV_SEQ$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG = 'E'
UPDATE KEP_DA SET IF_FLAG = 'Z' WHERE 1 = 1 AND LEGACY_IV_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_IV_NO$' AND LEGACY_IV_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_IV_SEQ$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$'
